info.title: API-DocTest-List Ecommerce Cart Summarys-v4-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Summary API provides retailers with real-time insights into the contents and status of their customers' shopping carts. This endpoint allows merchants to retrieve a summary of items currently held in a customer's cart, including product details, quantities, and total price. It is essential for use cases such as analyzing customer behaviors, optimizing conversion strategies, and personalizing shopping experiences. Retail developers and businesses can leverage this API to enhance their ecommerce platforms and improve customer engagement.

get.summary: Retrieve the current summary of the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a summary of the items present in the shopping cart, including total quantities, prices, and any applicable discounts. It helps users to understand their current selections before proceeding to checkout.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the summary of the user's shopping cart. This body uses JSON format to request the essential information about the items present in the cart.
